name: Sapporo (Japan)

colors.symbolism: the sky and the Toyohira River

description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sapporo city emblem: a six-sided snowflake-shaped device parted green and blue, bearing a white ring enclosing a five-pointed star.
history: The flag bears the municipal emblem of Sapporo, the capital of Hokkaido, on a white field; the emblem's snowflake-and-star design draws on the red star used by the 19th-century Hokkaido Development Commission.

features.role: Sapporo city emblem — a hexagonal snowflake parted green and blue with a white ring and five-pointed star
features.symbolism: the hexagon evokes a snowflake and Sapporo's snowy climate; the star is the pioneers' polestar of Hokkaido's development era; the ring stands for the city itself
